passives.name: Heavenly Qi Absorption
passives.desc: Your meridians pull at the world's Qi without being asked.

passives.name: Iron Bone Constitution
passives.desc: Bones like poured iron. Blows land softer.

passives.name: Spiritual Perception
passives.desc: You see the shape of Qi before it moves.

passives.name: Sword Heart
passives.desc: The blade is an extension of intent, not of the arm.

passives.name: Natural Formation Affinity
passives.desc: Lines of force arrange themselves to your convenience.

passives.name: Beast Taming Instinct
passives.desc: Beasts read your intent and choose not to test it.

passives.name: Swift Steps
passives.desc: Years on mountain paths, never once slipping.

passives.name: Void Affinity
passives.desc: Distance is a suggestion you have learned to decline.

passives.name: Bloodline Suppression
passives.desc: Lesser bloodlines lower their eyes before yours.
